title: Postex System User Guide
author: Anna L Crofts
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8jxhupn

steps.title: Set Up Tripods and Transponders
steps.instruction: Assemble and orient the tripod system over the plot center.

substeps.instruction: Attach two tripods, unfold, and extend all legs/arms.
Position the tripod centered over the plot center.
Level the tripod by placing a level in the center and adjusting until upper arms are on the same horizontal plane.
Use a compass to orient the upper arms so one arm faces north.
Place activated transponders in adapters on the upper arms: black transponder facing north, white transponder southwest, and green transponder southeast.

steps.title: Activate Transponders
steps.instruction: Use the DP II handheld device to power on the transponders.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to Settings → System → Test → DpDme → MEAS.
Aim the DP DME towards the ultrasound transceiver of each transponder.
Confirm activation by listening for two short beeps from the transponders.

steps.title: Calibrate DP DME
steps.instruction: Calibrate the DP DME at ambient air temperature (do not keep the device in your pocket) at least once daily or before every sample plot.

substeps.instruction: Using a tape, measure exactly 10 m in any direction from the center of the white transponder, keeping the tape level and tight.
Hold the DP II handheld device at the 10 m mark and aim the DP DME towards the white transponder.
Navigate to Settings → System → Test → DpDme → CAL.
Verify that 'Cal-OK' is displayed to complete calibration.

steps.title: Create New Plot
steps.instruction: Initialize a new plot in the DP II handheld device and mount the hardware.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to Plots → New Plot.
Enter the desired ID, set RADIUS to 15 m, and set COORD to 'Cartesian'.
When prompted for 'Plot Coord.?', press the right arrow to select NO and press Enter.
Mount the DP II handheld device onto the SmartScale Caliper.

steps.title: Verify Calibration and Setup
steps.instruction: Test the system by measuring the length of the upper tripod arms.

substeps.instruction: If 'PostexDME' is missing from the plot menu, go to Settings → Postex DME, check the box with the right arrow, and press Enter.
Aim the DP DME downwards towards the tripod's center.
Select PostexDME Dist 1 in the plot menu and press Enter.
Verify that the three distances to transponders diverge by no more than 1 cm and measure between 117 cm and 120 cm.
If requirements are not met: ensure arms are fully extended; if still incorrect, recalibrate the DP DME and repeat the check.

steps.title: Measure Trees
steps.instruction: Collect tree data using the DP II handheld device and SmartScale caliper.

substeps.instruction: If not prompted for angle, go to Settings → Angle to Plotc, check the box with the right arrow, and press Enter.
In the plot menu, select Measure.
Enter the ANGLE (measured by LaserGeo or equivalent) and press Enter.
Enter the species code (SPEC) and press Enter.
Place calipers at DBH of the tree with the DP DME aimed towards the tripod and press Enter to measure diameter (D).
Press Enter to take distance measurements (Ds) and XY coordinates.
Enter the height (H) as measured by LaserGeo or alternate clinometer and press Enter.
If the calculated distance to the plot center exceeds the plot radius, the device will beep; decide whether to save the tree.

steps.title: Deactivate Transponders and Disassemble
steps.instruction: Power down the system and remove equipment.

substeps.instruction: In the plot menu, select PostexDME Dist.
Aim the DP DME towards the ultrasound transceiver of each transponder until four short beeps are heard.
Disassemble the tripods.

steps.title: Export Data
steps.instruction: Transfer collected plot data to a computer.

substeps.instruction: In the main menu, select Print All → Comma separ. → To File (the screen will indicate deleting the existing .csv file).
In the main menu, select USB.
Connect the DP II to a computer and locate the data in the DATA → POSTAX folder as separate .csv files.

steps.title: Maintain Hardware
steps.instruction: Manage batteries and calibrate the SmartScale caliper.

substeps.instruction: Charge DP II and SmartScale using a USB converter and microUSB to USB cord; for faster charging, put the DP II in USB mode.
Replace transponder batteries by twisting off the lid and inserting one alkaline AA (1.5V) battery per transponder.
Check SmartScale calibration by navigating to Settings → System → Test → Scale and comparing the displayed diameter to a manual reading.
To calibrate the caliper: go to Settings → System → Calibrate, place the moveable jaw at 0 cm and press Enter, then place it at 50 cm and press Enter.
